text: EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT
THIS EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT (the “Contract”) is made on this 1st day of September 2026 (the Signing Date)
BETWEEN:
(1) Nexis Africa Ghana Ltd, a company incorporated under the laws of the Republic of Ghana (the “Employer”); AND
(2) ALICE DENNIS EWURAKUA of 15 Nuumo Nii Sai Ave, Haatso, Accra (the “Employee”),
WHEREAS the Employer wishes to employ the Employee, and the Employee has agreed to accept such employment,
NOW IT IS HEREBY AGREED as follows:
DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION“the Act” means the Labour Act, 2003 (Act 651), as amended;
“Commencement Date” means 1st September 2026;
Clause headings are for convenience only and do not affect interpretation.
POSITION, DUTIES AND PLACE OF WORKThe Employee is employed in the position of Junior Admin Coordinator.
The Employee shall perform the duties set out in Schedule 2 (Job Description).
COMMENCEMENT, DURATION AND PROBATIONThis Contract takes effect on the Commencement Date.
HOURS OF WORKThe Employee’s working hours shall be in accordance with Ghanaian labour law.
REMUNERATION AND BENEFITSThe Employer shall pay the Employee a gross salary of [ ] Ghana Cedis per month.
ANNUAL LEAVEThe Employee is entitled to not less than fifteen (15) working days’ leave.
SICK LEAVEThe Employee is entitled to sick leave, independent of annual leave.
MATERNITY LEAVEThe Employee is entitled to not less than twelve (12) weeks’ maternity leave.
DATA PROTECTIONThe Employer shall process the Employee’s personal data only for legitimate purposes.
CONFIDENTIALITY“Confidential Information” means all non-public information relating to the business.
This clause survives termination of this Contract for any reason.
INTELLECTUAL PROPERTYAll work product created by the Employee shall belong exclusively to the Employer.
CONDUCT, CONFLICTS AND DISCIPLINEThe Employee shall comply with the Employer’s code of conduct.
TERMINATIONEither Party may terminate this Contract by giving not less than one (1) month’s written notice.
RETURN OF PROPERTYOn termination of employment for any reason, the Employee shall return all property.
NON-SOLICITATIONFor a period of six (6) months after termination, the Employee shall not solicit any client.
GOVERNING LAW AND DISPUTE RESOLUTIONThis Contract is governed by the laws of the Republic of Ghana.
GENERALThis Contract, together with its Schedules, constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties.
No variation of this Contract is effective unless made in writing and signed by both Parties.
EXECUTION
Signed for and on behalf of NEXIS AFRICA GHANA LTD by its duly authorized officer:
